LanguageData.Merthsoft_FloodFill_Settings_RestrictToR: Restrict flood fill to revealed cells

When enabled, flood fill cannot start in or spread through fogged cells or concealed natural rock and ore. Rock and ore must have a cardinal face next to an unfogged cell without a full solid structure. Diagonal-only exposure and enclosed interiors are excluded. When disabled (default), existing ore scouting behavior is preserved.
